authorization: Execute authorized CPU preparation and bounded conditional PPO work, stop at first necessary GPU migration; no local GPU execution or publication

questions.primary: Do lifecycle prediction changes alter candidate feasibility assessment and the deployment consequences of the fixed historical selection?
questions.guard: Whole-guard comparisons at fixed threshold; threshold comparisons at fixed guard; preserve historical tie sensitivity
questions.conditional_PPO: Same algorithm, mixed workload, paired seeds, only training startup endpoint differs; no requirement to beat rules

initial_state: two active ready instances, empty queues; target state 2; non-preemptive drain

feasibility.P1plus: every online and offline arrival completes by its own deadline; no unfinished; online>0 and offline=120
feasibility.historical_P1: online on_time>=0.99*arrivals; offline on_time=120 and arrivals=120; no unfinished
feasibility.legacy_summary_feasible: retain unchanged but never substitute its 95% offline gate for study P1/P1plus

data.development: six known historical C2 windows: three train, three validation
data.final: two newly generated windows only after current GPU preflight disposition and final policy freeze; no generation in this initial CPU phase
data.candidate_selection: deterministic source-arrival criteria and SHA order; no policy-outcome filtering

environment.mismatch: HOLD_ENV_MISMATCH before final inputs; no automatic budget reset; documented A historical-transfer or new development contract only
environment.status_basis: Recent E1 v3 setup ready and ready_during_stopping do not measure ordinary window launch-to-ready; current endpoint has not yet been measured, not an observed mismatch or PPO failure.
environment.runtime_lineage: E1 v3 lifecycle-corrected physical runtime; exact source closure and SHA must be locked and independently reviewed in the development preflight package before GPU execution.

PPO.selection_evaluator: C30 under shared contract, guard off
PPO.any_group_without_eligible_checkpoint: both PPO physical arms NOT_RUN_TRAINING_GATE; F4 may continue

stop_rules.GPU: do not run CUDA workers or GPU probes on this host; package the first required preflight then stop
stop_rules.scientific_failures: preserve; never retry to improve outcome
stop_rules.paper: frozen sources/PDF/materials untouched before scientific evidence
stop_rules.public_actions: no push, release, external messages or Claude package
